plugins.name: postnitro
plugins.description: Create on-brand social media carousels, image posts and animated videos (motion styles, music, an AI voiceover) and schedule them to LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, Facebook Pages, and Pinterest — generate from a topic, article, or X thread, or import your own slides, then read and edit them in place. Scriptable from the CLI.
